game.title: Harvest Moon: Hero of Leaf Valley
game.japanese_title: 牧場物語 シュガー村とみんなの願い

bachelorettes.name: Alice
bachelorettes.bio: A confident executive from the city who represents the Funland Company. She visits Leaf Valley to survey the land for a potential amusement park project. She is sharp, business-focused, and often clashes with the villagers' traditional way of life, though she shows a hidden curiosity about the valley's charm.

schedule.note: Alice does NOT have a fixed daily schedule. She appears during specific events and mecha battles. After completing all 5 mecha events and making correct choices, she stays in Leaf Valley and can be found at the Church or walking in the Valley.

marriage_requirements.confession_scene: Must witness her confession at end of Year 2 (highest affection)
marriage_requirements.special: Her confession takes priority over all candidates in tie situations

bachelorettes.name: Aurelia
bachelorettes.bio: A gentle and spiritual woman who travels with the priest Chester. She has a deep connection to music and nature, often seen playing her ocarina near the church or by the lake. She is mysterious at first but warms up quickly to those who appreciate the arts and the quiet beauty of the valley.

bachelorettes.name: Dia
bachelorettes.bio: Young lady who lives at the villa. She spends her days reading. She is very shy, and spends most of her time at home reading books. She was left in Martha's care when her parents divorced, and this seems to have left a bit of an emotional scar on her. She hates going outdoors.

crushed_on_by: Kurt (implied - he knows her schedule for Golden Potato events)

bachelorettes.name: Gina
bachelorettes.bio: A polite and hardworking maid who serves Dia. Gina is incredibly skilled at sewing and cleaning, often putting the needs of others before her own. She is shy and reserved, rarely venturing far from the villa, but she has a hidden passion for fashion design and creating beautiful things.

bachelorettes.name: Katie
bachelorettes.bio: Very cheery and motivated, Katie works at the Sunny Garden Cafe. Katie is an energetic young lady who loves sweets, but may be sensitive about her cooking skills sometimes. She is a precocious sixteen year old who wants to grow up before her time. At night, Katie stays in her bedroom as she is forbidden by Wallace to enter the Moon Garden bar.

story_path.name: The Tale of the Cake Contest
key_requirements: AAF=200 (All Affection)
Keep Horse
Gold Egg + Milk G in inventory for final event

bachelorettes.name: Lyla
bachelorettes.bio: The owner of the local flower shop. Lyla is a calm, quiet, and gentle young woman who often seems lost in her own dreams. She is a romantic at heart, frequently daydreaming about true love and a happy future. Despite her shy and reserved nature, she possesses a mature wisdom beyond her years and a deep appreciation for the beauty of nature.

relationships.crush_on: Parsley (unrequited - he has a girlfriend in another town)

bachelorettes.name: Gwen
bachelorettes.bio: A tomboyish and energetic girl who spends her time exploring the forests and fields. She has a deep love for wildlife and is always concerned about the well-being of the local creatures. She is straightforward and honest, with a strong sense of justice for nature.

bachelorettes.name: Marina
bachelorettes.bio: A gentle young woman with a deep connection to nature and the valley's history who appears near the Goddess Spring. She is said to only show herself on sunny days to those with a pure heart. While she claims to be a local resident, rumors persist that she is more than she seems, perhaps serving as a bridge between the mortal world and the divine, though her true origins remain a secret.

schedule.note: Only visible at Goddess Spring Year 3 after specific secret choice.

marriage_requirements.heart_level: Red (350 FP) - MUST be highest of ALL bachelorettes
marriage_requirements.event_path_completed: Tale of the Harvest Goddess Temple (requires Moonlight Stones)
marriage_requirements.confession_scene: Must witness her confession at end of Year 2
marriage_requirements.blue_feather: Throw an offering to her and make a wish (cannot hand directly)
marriage_requirements.special: Requires Moonlight Stones for temple event. Real name revealed only after completing event.

villagers.name: Louis
villagers.bio: The owner of the local item shop and a brilliant but eccentric inventor. He is always tinkering with new gadgets and machines, often creating unique tools for the villagers. He is gruff on the outside but has a kind heart and is eager to help the town with his inventions.

villagers.name: Parsley
villagers.bio: A quiet botanist who studies the unique plant life of Leaf Valley. He spends his days exploring the fields and forests, collecting seeds and studying flora. He is reserved and focused on his work, but he is passionate about the natural world and shares his knowledge with those who ask.

spring_summer.note: Present in valley during Spring and Summer

fall.note: LEAVES the valley in Fall (goes to study elsewhere)

relationships.girlfriend: Girlfriend in another town (name not given)
crushed_on_by: Lyla (unrequited - dashed when she learns of his girlfriend)

villagers.name: Bob
villagers.bio: A hardworking rancher who manages Starling Ranch and sells barn supplies. He is a kind father figure to many in the town and loves to talk about his animals, especially his horses. He believes in the power of hard work and dedication and is always willing to lend a hand.

villagers.name: Tim
villagers.bio: Bob's younger brother and an outgoing treasure hunter who loves adventure. He spends his days exploring the mines and valleys, always looking for something new. He is friendly and talkative, often sharing hints and stories about the town's hidden secrets.

villagers.name: Kurt
villagers.bio: A stoic and focused apprentice carpenter who works alongside his brother Joe. He is dedicated to his craft and takes pride in his work. Though he is quiet and gruff on the outside, he has a sensitive side and cares deeply about the quality of his creations.

relationships.crush_on: Dia (implied - knows her schedule for Golden Potato events)

villagers.name: Joe
villagers.bio: Kurt's older brother and a skilled carpenter. He is more outgoing than his brother and enjoys talking to the villagers about his work. He is passionate about woodworking and is always willing to help with construction projects around the valley.

villagers.name: Chester
villagers.bio: The local priest and a strong believer in the Harvest Goddess. He is the most talkative resident in the valley, often telling stories and jokes to anyone who will listen. Despite his playful nature, he is deeply knowledgeable about the town's history and spiritual matters.

villagers.name: Charles
villagers.bio: One of Alice's bodyguards, Charles is a narcissistic and single-minded man who loves tinkering with machines. He often compares Leaf Valley unfavorably to the city and can be quite arrogant. However, he is loyal to Alice and takes his job seriously.

schedule.note: Appears during mecha events and Alice's visits. Not on a fixed daily schedule.

villagers.name: Renton
villagers.bio: The other bodyguard for Alice, Renton is short, chubby, and has a much better attitude than Charles. He is more humble and often blames himself when things go wrong. He is loyal to Alice but seems to have a softer spot for the villagers.

schedule.note: Appears during mecha events and Alice's visits. Not on a fixed daily schedule.

villagers.name: Rudolph
villagers.bio: A silent and grumpy miner who works for the Funland Company in the local mine. He keeps his eyes closed most of the time and rarely speaks, but he is a skilled worker who knows the mine better than anyone. He offers part-time jobs to visitors.

part_time_job.limit: 5 times before you can mine for free
part_time_job.reward: Gold + experience (or keep everything after 5 shifts)

villagers.name: Zann
villagers.bio: A strange and eccentric merchant who appears randomly in the valley. He has a peculiar interest in items that others consider useless, such as scrap metal and junk. He trades these items for gemstones to craft unique accessories.

schedule.note: Appears randomly in the Valley. Not on a fixed schedule. Can be found near the Plaza or walking paths.
schedule.appearance: Random - check Valley area during daytime

villagers.special_ability: For every 10 scrap metal brought, he asks for a gemstone and crafts an accessory (jewelry)

villagers.name: Ponta
villagers.bio: A mysterious tanuki spirit that only the hero can see. Ponta appears at fishing spots and offers advice on fishing techniques. He is playful and helpful, guiding the hero to new fishing locations and sharing tips about the local fish.

gifts.note: Ponta accepts only fish to create Fish Prints. In return, he provides cooking recipes and removes the Goddess Pond rock at 10 prints, followed by the Underground Lake at 20.

schedule.note: Appears at fishing spots. Interact to unlock new fish locations and get hints.

villagers.special_ability: Unlocks Salmon at Goddess Spring (Fall) and provides fishing tips

villagers.name: Ronald
villagers.bio: The owner of the local grocery store and a passionate baker. He is known for his famous bread and is always friendly to the townspeople. He enjoys interacting with customers and is a pillar of the community, often helping others with their needs.

villagers.name: Martha
villagers.bio: The matriarch of the Clove Villa and Dia's aunt. She is a kind and traditional woman who values family and tradition. She runs the villa with grace and is always willing to help her guests, especially Gina and Dia.

villagers.name: Woody
villagers.bio: A hardworking resident of the Clove Villa who helps around the carpenter's shop. He is known for his woodchopping skills and is always ready to lend a hand to the villagers. He is friendly and supportive, often offering advice to those in need.

tue_thu.note: NOT available for part-time job on Tuesday and Thursday

part_time_job.days: All days EXCEPT Tuesday and Thursday

villagers.name: Wallace
villagers.bio: A friendly resident of the Clove Villa who also owns the local pub. He is a bit of a character who loves to tell stories and gossip. He is always happy to serve a drink and hear the latest news, making him a central figure in the town's social life.

harvest_sprites.name: Harvest Goddess
harvest_sprites.bio: The ancient and powerful spirit of the valley, guardian of the seasons and the source of all fertility in Leaf Valley. In her true divine form, she is a radiant entity of pure light and nature, rarely seen by mortal eyes except in moments of great crisis or deep spiritual significance. She holds the power to grant blessings for bountiful harvests and to restore the land when it is in peril.

schedule.note: Only visible at Goddess Spring between 10 AM and 4 PM. Never on rainy days. Heart caps at 3 (Green) until Summer Year 2.

relationships.envy: Other girls are slightly jealous of her status

harvest_sprites.name: Nic
harvest_sprites.bio: One of the three Harvest Sprites, Nic is the most childish and playful of the group. He often accompanies the Harvest Goddess and can be found near the farm or in the valley, bringing a sense of fun and mischief to the area.

harvest_sprites.name: Nac
harvest_sprites.bio: The leader of the three Harvest Sprites, Nac is more serious and responsible than his companions. He often takes charge of their tasks and ensures that the Harvest Goddess's wishes are carried out. He is loyal and dedicated to his role.

harvest_sprites.name: Flak
harvest_sprites.bio: The tallest and clumsiest of the Harvest Sprites, Flak is known for his good nature and lack of coordination. He often trips over his own feet but remains cheerful and optimistic. He is a source of comic relief and brings a light-hearted energy to the group.

events.requirements: You've experienced event 6-10

events.requirements: Gwen's FP must be at least 100

events.requirements: Gwen's FP must be at least 110
events.note: Gwen asks for help looking after Snowball's habitat.

events.requirements: Gwen's FP must be at least 120
events.note: Continued patrolling of the habitat.

events.requirements: Completed event path 3 (completed event 6-12)

story_paths_complete.name: The Tale of the Harvest Goddess Dress

story_paths_complete.name: The Tale of the Horse Champion

events.requirements: Finish Bob's part-time job
events.note: Bob asks if you are interested in raising horses/cattle. He warns that it is hard work but invites you to learn by working for him.

events.requirements: Bob must have 30+ FP, the animals on his ranch must have 40+, you haven't bought a horse yet
events.note: CRITICAL EVENT: Bob offers you a free horse if you haven't bought one. The color of the horse reflects the first one you gave attention to (e.g., speak to the black horse first for a black horse). This is the ONLY way to get a free horse of a specific color.

events.requirements: Bob must have 30+ FP, your horse must be at 30+ FP
events.note: Bob and Gwen visit to check on your horse. Bob thinks it will be a great racehorse; Gwen is skeptical of your ability.

events.requirements: Bob must have 40+ FP, your horse must be at 50+ FP and happy

events.requirements: only on Thursday. Bob must be at 50+ FP and your horse must be happy

events.requirements: only on thursday. You have beaten Bob in a race and your horse must be happy

events.requirements: You have seen event 11-4 and have registered for the race

events.requirements: You won the Qualifying Race in event 11-7

events.requirements: Bob must have 70+ FP and you have beaten the race in 11-8
events.note: Leaf Valley hosts the next races! Your horse has a reputation for beating mechanical horses. Funland stays out of future races.

events.requirements: Bob must have 80+ FP and you have seen event 11-9
events.note: Bob and Gwen celebrate at the Cafe. Bob jokes about Gwen being a rival. Tea, milk, and cakes served.

events.requirements: Bob must have 90+ FP and you have seen event 11-9
events.note: Bob asks for tips on raising horses. Gwen is there to ride. Bob admires your horse care skills.

events.requirements: Completed Event Path 13
events.note: Bob asks for souvenir ideas. You suggest horse-shaped cookies, which he starts selling in his store.

key_requirements: Must finish Bob's part-time job to trigger event 11-1
Event 11-2 (Free Horse) requires: Bob FP 30+, Ranch animals FP 40+, NO horse purchased yet

Race practice: Event 11-5 (Thursdays), Event 11-6 (Tuesdays)

events.requirements: Chester must have 20+ FP
events.note: Chester points out a suspicious cold rock near the church. Charles interrupts before you can warm it up.

events.requirements: Chester must have 30+ FP
events.note: You smash the monument with a strong hammer, revealing stairs. You find the painting, but it crumbles. Chester passes out from shock. Aurelia carries him to bed.

events.note: Chester apologizes and reveals a theory: he needs Rare Metal, Mineral Crystal, Orichalcum, and Blue Crystal to recreate the painting.

events.requirements: You have the materials (Rare Metal, Mineral Crystal, Orichalcum, Blue Crystal) in your bag
events.note: You deliver the ores to Chester in the church. He goes on a tangent about love and saving the Goddess.

events.requirements: Chester must have 50+ FP and you have seen event 14-10

events.requirements: Chester must have 70+ FP and you have seen event 14-11
events.note: Chester tells a story about the Goddess saving those with pure hearts. He ends the story early, expecting Aurelia to arrive soon.

events.requirements: Chester must have 80+ FP and you have seen event 14-12
events.note: Chester tells a story about a man who found the spring and was told to 'believe in me... and yourself.' The Harvest Sprites suspect it was Chester himself. The Goddess doesn't remember but accepts Chester's happiness.

events.requirements: Completed event path 12
events.note: Chester plans to sell souvenirs in the plaza to spread the Goddess's love. Aurelia thinks they are tasteless. The stand will sell a 'Shady Harvest Goddess Pendant' for a few thousand G.

Mine around 30 metals for event 14-6

power_berries.description: Power Berries increase max stamina by 20 and max fatigue resistance by 10.
locations: Flower/Tool Shop area - Left of flower bed by Lyla's store
Grocery Store area - Mound of earth in front of store (between 2 trees)
Cafe/Bar area - Tree near northern part of area
Goddess Spring - Near two trees in the middle
Mountain Crossroad - Center of area and/or top of stairs
power_berries.note: 4 can be found with dog (needs 3 hearts). 5th is from event with dog and Harvest Sprites.

requirements: Dog must have at least 3 hearts
Any Harvest Sprite must have at least 2 hearts
hidden_5th.trigger: Triggers when leaving house (any time, any weather)
hidden_5th.reward: Harvest Sprites give 5th Power Berry a few days later
hidden_5th.note: No need to find previous 4 Power Berries first

blue_mist_seeds.description: In Lyla's storyline, raise her to 20 FP and sell four crops to unlock Blue Mist Seeds.
blue_mist_seeds.location: Plant on patch at Harvest Goddess Pond
blue_mist_seeds.note: Auto-plant scene occurs randomly between the 2 trees at Goddess Pond

ending_determination.tourist_destination: Complete 3+ tourist paths (GPS, TotBB, TotCC, TSF, THF, TLB, LIK, THC)
ending_determination.bad_ending: Less than 50,000G AND fewer than 3 paths of any type completed

Ocarina: TotBB story path (Aurelia) - buy from Louis
Silk Thread: HGD story path (Gina) - buy from Louis
Silver Ore: Fishing rod upgrade / Cooking utensil upgrade (medium)
Gold Ore: Fishing rod upgrade (gold) / Cooking utensil upgrade (large)
Scrap Metal (x10): Trade with Zann for gemstone → accessory (earrings)
Blue Feather: Marriage proposal (buy from Louis, Year 3 Spring)
Lumber: House upgrades (Kitchen, Bath, Extra Bed, Storeroom)
